political layer v3 (2 Oct 2026): the three numbered Vasal Commonwealth polygons retired; a narrow *kerajaan marka* belt; the Satvan Pedalaman dispersal zone (dots, no border); Hesperia's ~50 provinces as three optional belts (24 · 19 · 7), the polygon itself unclipped; Foedera's claim and inhabited core; Kloaka's nominal claim and shifting zone; the vocabulary rule for *provinsi*; nine new audit cards; 27 layers; one shared territory style and order for the flat map, the globe and the working map

Also since v1.6.5: the Interregna redrawn as a varied mosaic (#9), plain territory borders without a halo (#10), thinner territory, route and front lines that shrink with zoom (#11).
